description: This file defines the class ConditionalFormattingRuleExtension, which extends the functionality for handling conditional formatting rules within PHPSpreadsheet. It includes methods for parsing XML extensions related to conditional formatting, especially Data Bars, generating UUIDs, and managing properties like rule IDs, references, and data bars.

classes.name: ConditionalFormattingRuleExtension
classes.description: A class to handle extended features for conditional formatting rules, particularly related to data bars, including parsing XML data, generating UUIDs, and managing rule properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with an ID and a default rule type (data bar). Generates a UUID if ID is not provided.

methods.name: generateUuid
methods.description: Generates a UUID string for identifying formatting rules.

methods.name: parseExtLstXml
methods.description: Parses an XML extension list for conditional formatting rules, particularly for data bars, and returns an array of parsed rule extension objects.

methods.name: parseExtDataBarAttributesFromXml
methods.description: Parses data bar attributes from XML and sets properties on a ConditionalDataBarExtension object.

methods.name: parseExtDataBarElementChildrenFromXml
methods.description: Parses child elements of a data bar XML and updates the ConditionalDataBarExtension accordingly.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the conditional formatting rule extension.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the rule extension.

methods.name: getCfRule
methods.description: Returns the type of conditional formatting rule.

methods.name: setCfRule
methods.description: Sets the type of conditional formatting rule.
